newsitem.title: USA: Photran hopes to complete probe by end of week.
newsitem.headline: Photran hopes to complete probe by end of week.

text.p: Photran Inc hopes to complete by the end of this week an internal investigation of financial and accounting irregularities at the company, Paul Fink, chief financial officer, said.
"I'm very hopeful it will be completed" by that time, Fink said.

He declined to comment on specifics of the investigation, which was announced earlier today, or how the suspected irregularities were discovered. He deferred answering those questions until the investigation is completed.
Photran shares were off 5/8 at two.
Earlier, Photran said it was conducting an internal investigation and expects to report a loss for the fourth quarter and full year of 1996. It may also restate results issued thus far this year.
Photran also announced Monday that David Stevenson, president and chief executive officer, and his wife, Kathleen Stevenson, corporate secretary, have resigned.
